issues.description: Owner agent-e: Rewrite to the mandatory brief output contract; this summary has 3 quantitative result objects (maximum 2) and 8 beginner concepts (allowed 3–5).

Owner agent-b: Remove distributed-systems, network-security, and defense. Silhouette is a persistent-memory file-system crash-consistency bug-finding tool; internal replication is a checked consistency mechanism, not a distributed/security-defense contribution.

Owner agent-e: Remove Figure 7 from the two-crash-plan result locator. The supporting two-plan prose is on physical PDF pages 9–10, while Figure 7 depicts journaling in-flight periods and does not support that claim.

notes: Reopened the official USENIX paper page and PDF; checked metadata, relevance, mechanism, assumptions, evaluation, baselines, every numeric claim and locator, and limitations.
Checked official group/faculty evidence, FAST 2025 awards, repository-wide duplicate titles, and stored link targets.
